newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore oil product prices collapse with crude.
newsitem.headline: Singapore oil product prices collapse with crude.

text.p: Singapore oil products closed sharply lower on Wednesday on a loss of over $1.00 a barrel in crude prices since the start of this week, traders said.
Only fuel oil withstood the crude collapse following strong buying interest from a local trader and prices were discussed at $120.50/$121.50 a tonne, up 50 cents from Tuesday.
The big fall to crude prices were due to API figures which showed that crude oil stocks rose 324,000 barrels, distillates stocks climbed by over two million barrels.
Physical gas oil and jet fuel prices fell more than $1.00 a barrel on strong selling pressure.
